evidence_boundary: The red-team map confirms the uniform-static algebra and records concrete counterexamples to finite-spectrum, causal and current-HOLO promotion. The comparison target inherits a SPARC training fit; no raw observation table is read here. Priorities are attack severity, not probabilities. No physical force, lensing, discovery or publication claim is authorized.

priority_actions.action: Construct a finite canonical regulator and bound the cubic window before taking a->0.
Derive the full retarded kernel and canonical constraint/principal-symbol spectrum.
Find an anomaly-free RG-invariant cancellation rule for the a-squared operator.
Derive the spectral fiber and Clifford vertex from a covariant extension of the current bulk.
Freeze one matter metric and solve two conserved source geometries for force, slip and lensing.

An onsite continuum is an infinite internal fiber, not a finite 3+1 QFT.
The zero-gap fermion bubble has a nonanalytic temporal kernel.

A spherical constitutive equation does not fix two metric potentials or universal matter coupling.
